checks.detail: Event sequence, digest chain and every referenced blob verified.
All raw events belong to the declared run.
Completion marker agrees with the original scenario.
BSC testnet source block recorded; all writes are on loopback fork.
Every submitted transaction has a matching successful receipt and block.
Each transaction targets its recorded SDK operation contract.
Created job is OPEN, belongs to the ephemeral client, and remains unfunded.
SDK cancelOpen transitions the same unfunded job from OPEN(0) to REJECTED(4). This is not a funded refund.
Create and cancel each have their own successful receipt.
Snapshot restoration removes the created identity/job from local chain state.

limitations: Actual deployed bytecode on local BSC testnet fork; not a public-network transaction.
ERC-8183 scope is unfunded create/cancel; no delivery, funded settlement or refund claim.
Fixed-block replay requires an upstream RPC retaining that historical state.
